SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT incoming_delivery_detail.id, incoming_delivery.slip_date, incoming_delivery.supplier_id, incoming_delivery_detail.product_cd, product.name AS product_name, incoming_delivery_detail.specification, incoming_delivery_detail.quantity_unit, incoming_delivery_detail.box_quantity, incoming_delivery_detail.quantity, unit.name AS unit_name, incoming_delivery_detail.unit_price, incoming_delivery_detail.amount, incoming_delivery_detail.remark FROM incoming_delivery_detail JOIN incoming_delivery ON incoming_delivery_detail.incoming_delivery_id = incoming_delivery.id LEFT JOIN product ON incoming_delivery_detail.product_cd = product.product_cd LEFT JOIN unit ON incoming_delivery_detail.unit_id = unit.id WHERE incoming_delivery.supplier_id = ':1' AND incoming_delivery_detail.product_cd = ':2' AND incoming_delivery.slip_date BETWEEN ':3' AND ':4' ORDER BY incoming_delivery.slip_date DESC;
